newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore, Malaysia foreign ministers affirm ties.
newsitem.headline: Singapore, Malaysia foreign ministers affirm ties.

text.p: Foreign ministers of Singapore and Malaysia, meeting on the fringes of the Non-Aligned ministerial conference in New Delhi on Monday, had recognised the value of good relations, state television reported.
But it quoted Singapore's foreign minister Shanmugam Jayakumar as saying both countries realised they might need some time for relations to return to normal.
Malaysia's Foreign Minister Abdullah Badawi added that both countries must ensure that they do not make any kind of statement across the causeway that might affect bilateral relations.
The two sometimes testy neighbours fell out in March over a statement by Singapore Senior Minister Lee Kuan Yew.

Lee described Johor Baru, a Malaysian city just across a short causeway from Singapore, as a dangerous place rife with crime. The comments, which Lee later retracted, sparked diplomatic and public protests in Malaysia and calls for a freeze in relations.
